name: clinical-trials-ai
description: Search clinical trials, evaluate eligibility, compare trials, and retrieve endpoint data. Uses a reference database for demonstration purposes.

tools.name: search_trials
tools.description: Search clinical trials by condition, drug, phase, status, or location.

tools.name: check_eligibility
tools.description: Evaluate whether a patient meets eligibility criteria for a specific trial. Conditions as comma-separated string.

tools.name: get_trial_details
tools.description: Get comprehensive details for a specific clinical trial.

tools.name: compare_trials
tools.description: Compare multiple clinical trials side by side. Pass trial IDs as comma-separated string.

tools.name: get_trial_endpoints
tools.description: Get detailed primary and secondary endpoint information for a trial.
